sentences.cn_text: 《科学》杂志主编玛西娅·麦克纳特今日宣布，该刊正在其同行评审流程中增加一轮额外的统计审查。
sentences.en_text: The journal Science is adding an extra round of statistical checks to its peer-review process, editor-in-chief Marcia McNutt announced today.

sentences.cn_text: 在各界广泛担忧数据分析中的基本错误正导致众多已发表研究成果无法重现之后，该政策效仿了其他期刊的类似举措。
sentences.en_text: The policy follows similar efforts from other journals, after widespread concern that basic mistakes in data analysis are contributing to the irreproducibility of many published research findings.

sentences.cn_text: 麦克纳特在一篇社论中写道：「读者必须对我们期刊发表的结论充满信心。」
sentences.en_text: “Readers must have confidence in the conclusions published in our journal,” writes McNutt in an editorial.

sentences.cn_text: 该刊与美国统计学会合作，任命七位专家组成统计审稿编辑委员会（SBoRE）。
sentences.en_text: Working with the American Statistical Association, the journal has appointed seven experts to a statistics board of reviewing editors (SBoRE).

sentences.cn_text: 稿件将由期刊内部编辑、现有审稿编辑委员会或外部同行评审员标记出来，接受额外审查。
sentences.en_text: Manuscript will be flagged up for additional scrutiny by the journal’s internal editors, or by its existing Board of Reviewing Editors or by outside peer reviewers.

sentences.cn_text: 随后，SBoRE 委员会将邀请外部统计学家对这些稿件进行审查。
sentences.en_text: The SBoRE panel will then find external statisticians to review these manuscripts.

sentences.cn_text: 当被问及是否有特定论文促成了这一变革时，麦克纳特表示：「统计委员会的设立源于对科学研究中统计与数据分析应用的广泛担忧，也是《科学》杂志提升我们所发表研究可重现性这一整体努力的一部分。」
sentences.en_text: Asked whether any particular papers had impelled the change, McNutt said: “The creation of the ‘statistics board’ was motivated by concerns broadly with the application of statistics and data analysis in scientific research and is part of Science’s overall drive to increase reproducibility in the research we publish.”

sentences.cn_text: 哈佛大学公共卫生学院生物统计学家、SBoRE 委员会成员乔瓦尼·帕米吉亚尼表示，他预计该委员会将「主要发挥咨询作用」。
sentences.en_text: Giovanni Parmigiani, a biostatistician at the Harvard School of Public Health, a member of the SBoRE group, says he expects the board to “play primarily an advisory role”.

sentences.cn_text: 他之所以同意加入，是因为他「发现设立 SBoRE 背后的远见具有新颖性和独特性，并可能产生持久影响」。
sentences.en_text: He agreed to join because he “found the foresight behind the establishment of the SBoRE to be novel, unique and likely to have a lasting impact.

sentences.cn_text: 这种影响不仅将通过《科学》杂志自身的出版物得以体现，而且有望通过更多可能希望效仿《科学》做法的出版机构实现。
sentences.en_text: This impact will not only be through the publications in Science itself, but hopefully through a larger group of publishing places that may want to model their approach after Science.”

sentences.cn_text: 研究方法学的医生约翰·伊奥尼迪斯称，该政策是「极受欢迎的进步」且「早就该实施了」。「大多数期刊在统计审查方面很薄弱，这损害了它们所发表内容的质量。」
sentences.en_text: John Ioannidis, a physician who studies research methodology, says that the policy is “a most welcome step forward” and “long overdue”. “Most journals are weak in statistical review, and this damages the quality of what they publish.

sentences.cn_text: 他表示：「我认为，对于当今大多数科学论文而言，统计审查比专家审查更为关键。」
sentences.en_text: I think that, for the majority of scientific papers nowadays, statistical review is more essential than expert review,” he says.

sentences.cn_text: 但他也指出，《内科医学年鉴》《美国医学会杂志》和《柳叶刀》等生物医学期刊都高度重视统计审查。
sentences.en_text: But he noted that biomedical journals such as Annals of Internal Medicine, the Journal of the American Medical Association and The Lancet pay strong attention to statistical review.

sentences.cn_text: 细胞生物学家戴维·沃克斯表示，专业科学家理应具备数据分析能力，但统计错误在已发表研究中却惊人地常见。
sentences.en_text: Professional scientists are expected to know how to analyse data, but statistical errors are alarmingly common in published research, according to David Vaux, a cell biologist.

sentences.cn_text: 他在 2012 年写道，研究人员应当提高自身标准，但期刊也应采取更严格的措施，「聘用精通统计的审稿人以及能够核实流程的编辑」。
sentences.en_text: Researchers should improve their standards, he wrote in 2012, but journals should also take a tougher line, “engaging reviewers who are statistically literate and editors who can verify the process”.

sentences.cn_text: 沃克斯表示，《科学》杂志将部分论文交由统计学家审查的做法「有一定价值，但其弱点在于它首先依赖审稿编辑委员会来识别需要审查的论文」。
sentences.en_text: Vaux says that Science’s idea to pass some papers to statisticians “has some merit, but a weakness is that it relies on the board of reviewing editors to identify ‘the papers that need scrutiny’ in the first place”
